intro: Portugal's economy runs on tourism, services, exports such as cork, wine, shoes and cars, and a fast-growing share of renewable energy.

chapters.title: What Portugal makes
text: Tourists flock to Lisbon, Porto, the Algarve and Madeira. Portugal is famous for port wine from the Douro Valley, cork, textiles, shoes and cars from a large Volkswagen factory.

chapters.title: Green power
text: Wind, hydro and solar power produce most of Portugal's electricity, and in 2023 the country ran on renewable power alone for six days in a row. After a debt crisis it needed an international bailout in 2011, but its economy has since recovered. Portugal uses the euro.

keyTerms.meaning: Power from sources such as wind, water and sun.
